modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler 的计划定义、target 执行协议、occurrence 幂等/终态、管理员路由权限，以及随包 Skill 对应用接入的指导。
modules.limitations: 未对多实例 Redis/BullMQ 与进程崩溃恢复做独立运行验证；仅评审归档验收和内存模式实现。

requirements.need: 业务管理员能看到计划、真实触发和每次执行结果，并启停计划。
requirements.responsibility: Scheduler 提供计划投影、管理员路由、occurrence 记录和目标执行协议；应用负责业务逻辑与页面。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 Provider.boot 注册 target、defineSchedule，按 Skill 自建列表/详情页并用同一 page:scheduler.schedules/access 授权。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用注册 todos.expiry-check 目标和 30 秒计划，设置页消费 scheduler/schedules 与 occurrences；验收观察到真实触发、结果 JSON、启停持久化。

requirements.need: 计划定义在启动时可校验、不可变，target 配置不含凭据。
requirements.responsibility: defineSchedule 校验并规范化定义，深冻结并生成 definitionHash；target 通过 validate/start 扩展。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 提供稳定 key、明确 cron/timezone、业务配置和幂等 start，不使用 target.config 传凭据。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用使用稳定 key、Asia/Shanghai 时区和空 config，start 调用领域服务并返回稳定结果。

requirements.need: 重复投递、并发触发或进程重试不能重复执行同一 occurrence。
requirements.responsibility: dispatch 用 jobId 作为 occurrenceId，store 对 waiting/终态 noop、对 pending/running 条件更新并用唯一插入处理并发。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 业务侧仍需设计外部副作用幂等；框架只保证 occurrence 记录与启动不重复。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用重复执行只更新已有过期记录，验收 B02 显示待办总数不增加、执行结果稳定。

requirementFit.reason: 直接覆盖计划、真实触发、执行历史、启停权限和幂等；唯一非框架职责是管理员页面由应用构建。

usability.reason: Skill 与 operations 给出完整路由、权限和页面职责，目标协议清晰；插件按设计不提供页面，且 title/description 只是字符串，非英语展示需应用自行翻译。

agentFriendliness.reason: 公开导出、示例和 provider 生命周期说明充分；但深层子路径不是 package export，初学者可能误用，且部分测试环境配置需从其他 Skill 拼合。

design.reason: schedule/target/occurrence 分层清晰，定义不可变并带 hash，权限在建路由时统一执行；页面留给应用是明确且合理的边界。

reliability.reason: occurrence 幂等、状态守卫更新、唯一插入、终态集合和 skip/error 分支均有实现；浏览器验收的真实周期触发与重复执行结果一致。

modules.name: 数据库迁移、种子与查询仓储
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/db 的迁移/种子公开 API、事务仓储 updateMany/count、索引与种子数据接入。
modules.limitations: 未验证所有数据库方言的索引/事务差异；评审基于归档 SQLite 验收和源码。

requirements.need: 为逾期检查建立可重复迁移的 todos 表和匹配过滤条件的索引。
requirements.responsibility: defineMigration 提供迁移标记与 builder；Collection builder 创建字段和复合索引。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 迁移 up 创建字段与 completed,expired,dueAt 复合索引，down 可逆删除。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用迁移创建四字段和 idx_todos_expiry_scan，与应用 updateMany 的过滤顺序一致。

requirements.need: 种子提供可重复安装的逾期/未来/已完成样例。
requirements.responsibility: defineSeed/Seeder 从包目录发现并执行种子，SeedContext 提供 repository/query/connection。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 以稳定 id upsert 样例行，sample 种子只在明确启用样例数据时运行。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用种子定义三条稳定样例，验收显示逾期、未来和已完成三种状态。

requirements.need: 一次调度在一个事务中批量标记，并原子读取总数。
requirements.responsibility: Connection.transaction 提供同连接 Repository；updateMany 返回 updatedCount，count 可在同一事务执行。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 transaction 回调中 updateMany+count，过滤条件使用字段布尔/日期 DSL。
requirements.actualUsage: TodoService 在 transaction 内 updateMany 未完成/未过期/dueAt<now 的行并 count，返回 marked/total/checkedAt。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移、种子、事务批量更新和计数均由公开 API 直接支持，应用接入路径完整。

usability.reason: defineMigration/defineSeed 与 transaction/repository DSL 一致，类型和文档清楚；种子样例需要应用自行保证幂等。

agentFriendliness.reason: 公开入口集中、示例明确；仓储返回类型在未选择字段时可能变宽，应用需断言，属于可理解的类型边界。

design.reason: 迁移/种子/仓储职责分明，事务连接隔离，updateMany 的写策略与字段校验在适配器前执行。

reliability.reason: 事务回调保证批量更新与计数同连接；验收 B02 重复执行不新增记录，状态保持正确。

modules.name: 应用服务、路由与授权集成
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-server 路由组合、@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization 的 database policy 以及 @nocobase/service-provider 的可选依赖解析在应用路由/Provider 中的组合。
modules.limitations: 未独立复现无插件运行时的所有 Provider 组合；依据应用代码、归档测试和框架接口评估。

requirements.need: 受保护的待办读取路由，使用统一认证、授权中间件与 OpenAPI 错误格式。
requirements.responsibility: app-server 提供 defineApiRoutes 和描述/校验/错误 helper；authentication/authorization 插件提供中间件。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在路由工厂中 resolve 认证/授权服务，先中间件后在 handler 求 policy。
requirements.actualUsage: todos 路由挂 authentication.required()+authorization.middleware()，用 zod 校验分页并返回标准错误。

requirements.need: 列表只能返回当前主体被授权读取的 todos。
requirements.responsibility: DatabaseAuthorizationService.policyFor 将 read/create/update/delete 决策折成 Repository policy。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 读取前对 collection 求 policy，false 时拒绝，否则 repository.withPolicy(policy) 查询。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用对 todos 求 policy，read=false 返回 TODOS_READ_DENIED，否则 withPolicy 查询。

requirements.need: 应用 Provider 在缺少可选插件或 scheduler 的测试/嵌入运行时仍能 boot。
requirements.responsibility: ServiceResolver.has 允许先探测可选服务；Provider 生命周期要求 boot 返回 Promise<void>。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 对真正可选的 authorization/scheduler 先 has 再 resolve，缺失时跳过注册而不是让整个应用失败。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 Provider 已用 container.has 守卫 authorization 与 scheduler；修复前无插件测试集曾因无条件 resolve 崩溃。

requirementFit.reason: 路由组合、认证授权中间件和 policy 求值直接覆盖待办读取保护；可选服务需要应用自行组合守卫。

usability.reason: 路由 helper 与 policy API 清晰，但可选 Provider 依赖的 has 守卫分散在 Scheduler/其他 Skill，应用测试集缺插件时容易踩坑。

agentFriendliness.reason: 公开 API 明确且类型完整；深层导入不可用、可选 token 的测试上下文和路由 handler 泛型曾造成多轮 tsc/运行错误。

design.reason: app-server 只组合路由，认证/授权由插件贡献，数据库 policy 与 Repository 分离，边界合理。

reliability.reason: 认证中间件先于业务，policy=false 明确拒绝，policy 与 Repository 查询绑定；应用守卫了缺失可选服务，归档测试最终通过。

findings.title: Scheduler 的 occurrence 幂等与终态协议可靠
findings.detail: dispatch 用 jobId 作为 occurrenceId，store 对 waiting/终态 noop、对 pending/running 条件更新并用唯一插入处理并发；completed/accepted/skipped/failed 都有明确落点。
findings.impact: 重复投递或进程重试不会重复启动同一 firing，管理员看到的是可追踪的终态记录。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该协议，并在业务 target 文档中继续强调外部副作用仍需业务幂等。

findings.title: 计划 title/description 只有字符串契约，缺少本地化展示约定
findings.detail: ScheduleDefinition 的 title/description 是 string；应用把 i18n key 存入 title，自己的页面再翻译，但 REST/OpenAPI 消费者看到的是 key。
findings.impact: 非英语管理员在应用页面正常，但 API、Swagger 或外部管理端可能看到 todos.schedules.definition.title 这类 key。
findings.suggestedChange: 为 title/description 增加可选的本地化文本对象（或明确的 display key 约定），并在 schema/文档中说明 API 返回原文。

diagnosis.trigger: 应用以 i18n key 作为计划标题/描述写入 Scheduler。
diagnosis.expected: 管理员页面与 API 文档对同一计划显示可读文本，或明确区分 key 与展示文本。
diagnosis.actual: 定义与 REST 投影返回字符串 key；只有应用设置页调用 t() 翻译。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用页面翻译 title/description；API 消费方自行识别 key。
diagnosis.acceptance: Schema 支持本地化 title/description 或文档明确字符串契约，且应用不再把裸 key 暴露给非页面消费者。

feedbackReview.reason: 证据链完整支撑“仅字符串契约、缺少本地化/展示约定”这一改进点：公开类型 title: string、description?: string（E40），defineSchedule 只要求 title 非空（E1），字段表仅写“Required title / optional description”（E43），schema 只有 z.string()（E41），没有任何本地化文本对象或“API 返回原文”的说明。应用把 i18n key 写入 title/description（E20），存储与 REST 投影原样返回（E42、E41），设置页再 t() 翻译（E21），因此页面可读而 API/Swagger/外部管理端会看到裸 key，与候选描述一致。合理替代解释（纯应用误用、环境问题）不足以推翻：应用遵守的是同一工厂同步的应用 i18n 规则“所有用户可见文本走翻译 key”（E17），而 Scheduler 契约与文档既未说明 title 是纯展示文本、也未说明 REST 返回原文，改进空间存在于框架契约/文档一侧；浏览器验收通过（E39）只证明 UI 路径，不覆盖 API 消费者，故不能说明该改进点不存在。

checks.reason: 公开契约是纯字符串：ScheduleDefinition.title: string、description?: string（E40）；defineSchedule 只校验 title 存在、不处理本地化（E1）；definitions.md 字段表仅“Required title / optional description”，示例用字面量 'Daily maintenance'，未定义本地化对象或展示 key 约定（E43）。
已实现的投影原样透传：store.list() 把 definition.title 直接放进返回项（E42），OpenAPI 响应用例 title: z.string() 且无说明（E41），所以 REST/OpenAPI 消费者拿到的是定义里的字符串本身，此处即 key。

应用写入值确为 key：defineSchedule({title:'todos.schedules.definition.title', description:'...description'})（E20），设置页对 schedule.title/description 调 t() 才显示可读文本（E21）。这是应用按 E17“所有用户可见文本走翻译 key”的规则做的选择，不是装配错误；暴露 key 的缺口落在契约/文档未定义 API 投影语义。
该现象由契约与投影的静态行为决定，不依赖外部服务、凭据或运行环境；验收报告在真实浏览器环境中通过且页面显示正常（E39），恰好说明环境无法解释 API 中仍是 key，且该报告只覆盖 UI 路径，未核对 API 响应。
相关指引来自工厂同步的 Scheduler 包 Skill：它强调“meaningful task names”、以管理员 UI 可观测为目标（E5），字段文档仍只写 title/description 字符串（E43）；应用侧 i18n 规则要求 key（E17）。两者之间没有本地化/展示文本约定，属于包文档与契约的指引缺口，未发现工厂提示注入或模板覆盖等其他成因材料。

已检索 Scheduler 公开入口：ScheduleDefinition 无本地化 title 类型或 titleKey（E40），REST schema 也只有 z.string()（E41），存储层无翻译处理（E42）；应用自身只能在其页面翻译（E21）。相邻的集合目录已使用 {key, ns} 形式标题（E20 中 authorization.collections.add 的 title），说明此类本地化约定在框架内存在先例但 Scheduler 计划定义未提供，改进点并非已由现有能力满足。

findings.title: 迁移/种子/事务仓储公开 API 足以支撑可重复的过期扫描
findings.detail: @nocobase/db 公开 defineMigration、defineSeed、transaction 和 updateMany/count；应用迁移建立与过滤条件匹配的复合索引，种子使用稳定样例，服务在事务内批量更新并计数。
findings.impact: 数据准备、扫描与重复执行都有明确契约，避免全表扫描和半完成状态。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持迁移/种子/仓储分层，并在示例中继续展示索引与过滤条件对应。

findings.title: 路由、认证授权与数据库 policy 组合边界清晰
findings.detail: app-server 只组合 defineApiRoutes；authorization 插件提供 middleware 和 database.policyFor；应用先认证、再按 collection 求 policy，最后 withPolicy 查询。
findings.impact: 待办读取不会绕过记录级授权，错误和 OpenAPI 契约由统一 router helper 生成。
findings.suggestedChange: 继续在路由示例中展示 policy=false 的显式 403 和 withPolicy 用法。

findings.title: 应用 locale 整组覆盖 settings 导致模板键丢失
findings.detail: 修复前应用在 en-US.ts 重新声明 settings 分组，没有 spread systemEnUS.settings，导致 settings.revokeTitle 等模板键消失、settings.retry 文案变化；修复后已 spread 系统分组。

evidence.excerpt:
## Decide Whether to Use Scheduler

The primary reason to define tasks through Scheduler is **UI observability for business administrators**. Developers define schedules and execution logic in code. Business administrators use the task list and detail pages the application builds on the Scheduler API to view schedules, track individual executions, and enable or disable tasks when authorized.

Tasks that do not need to be viewed and tracked through the UI must not be managed by the Scheduler plugin. Give recurring ones a `ScheduleExecutor` of their own from the application's jobs service (`jobExecutorServiceToken` in `@nocobase/app-server/jobs`), and one-off background work a `JobExecutor`; the application development Skill describes both. For administrator-visible tasks, deliver Client registration, access permissions, meaningful task names, and accurate final execution status together; successful server-side dispatch alone is incomplete.

## Then Choose the Execution Model

After deciding to use Scheduler, choose according to business complexity:

| Scenario                                                                                  | Choice          | Implementation boundary                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Periodic cleanup, cache refresh, a single report, or one business Service call            | Own target type | Short operations may complete directly; hand lengthy work to a `JobExecutor`                             |
| A simple operation that happens hourly                                                    | Own target type | Cron alone is not a reason to introduce a heavier execution system                                       |
| Immediate asynchronous execution                                                          | `JobExecutor`   | No Cron Schedule is needed                                                                               |
| A one-time delay, such as ten minutes after a request                                     | Queue `delay`   | No Cron Schedule is needed; `JobExecutor` has no delay                                                   |
| Another execution system with its own references, status queries, and completion protocol | Own target type | The same `registerTarget()` call, with `inspect()` and completion reporting for work that finishes later |

Every schedule points at a registered target; `registerTarget()` is the target extension surface, and there is no built-in target type. A target does not guarantee exactly-once external business effects; design business idempotency.

## Read by Task

- To create or change a schedule, read [Definitions, Registration, and Synchronization](references/definitions.md).
- To register or review a target, hand its work to a `JobExecutor`, report completion, or diagnose a historical occurrence after retargeting, read [Target Extensions and Execution Protocol](references/targets.md).
- To integrate or review the UI/API and permissions, interpret status, or diagnose missing definitions, read [Operations and Verification](references/operations.md), including the complete management route table, separate status dimensions, and application identity checks.

## Development Loop

1. Establish which tasks and execution records administrators need to see. Check Server/Client/CLI registration, page permissions, the application's `jobs` configuration (a `redis` adapter for more than one instance; `memory` serves one process) and `JobExecutorServiceProvider` composition and target availability, then choose or register the target type.
2. Implement business logic and Providers in application source, and call `schedulerServiceToken.defineSchedule(definition)` with an application-wide stable key from that Provider's `register()`/`boot()`.
3. Validate payload/input, timezone, idempotency, and the full asynchronous chain: submission, actual job execution, terminal notification, and recovery from persisted execution state. Obtain credentials through secure business Service configuration, never `target.config`.
4. Run application type checks, relevant tests, and build. Synchronize definitions and, in development, use an administrator account to find the task in the UI and track a real execution to its final state. Confirm the business result.

## Management Entry Points

The plugin contributes no pages: the application builds its schedule list and detail pages on the routes below and declares them among its own routes, guarded by the same permission. Definitions are maintained in source. The API supports viewing and enabling/disabling tasks, with no route for creating or editing Cron definitions.

All routes below require authentication and authorization for `{ resource: { type: 'page', id: 'scheduler.schedules' }, action: 'access' }`, checked before the schedule is looked up. Enabling/disabling currently uses the same permission, not a separate update action.

| Method and path                                        | Response / effect                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `GET /api/scheduler/schedules`                         | `{ data: ScheduleListItem[], meta: { page, pageSize, total } }`; `page` (default 1) and `pageSize` (default 20, at most 100)                                       |
| `GET /api/scheduler/schedules/:scheduleId`             | `{ data: ScheduleListItem }`                                                                                                                                       |
| `GET /api/scheduler/schedules/:scheduleId/occurrences` | `{ data: ScheduleOccurrenceView[], meta: { nextPageToken? } }`, newest first; `pageSize` (default 20, at most 100) and `pageToken` from the previous page's `meta` |
| `POST /api/scheduler/schedules/:scheduleId/enable`     | `{ data: ScheduleListItem }`; enables the task, no request body                                                                                                    |
| `POST /api/scheduler/schedules/:scheduleId/disable`    | `{ data: ScheduleListItem }`; pauses the task, no request body                                                                                                     |

Failures use the standard `/api` error body with domain `scheduler`: a caller without page access gets `403` with reason `SCHEDULE_ACCESS_REQUIRED`, an id this application has no schedule for gets `404` with reason `SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND`, and an invalid `page`, `pageSize` or `pageToken` gets `400` with reason `INVALID_INPUT`. Treat `pageToken` as opaque; the last page has no `nextPageToken`.

| File                             | Purpose                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client/locales/system/en-US.ts` | The template's own English copy: the shell, the sign-in pages under `auth.*`, shared components and the homepage. Exports the type `SystemResource`  |
| `client/locales/system/zh-CN.ts` | The template's own Chinese copy; typed as `SystemResource`                                                                                           |
| `client/locales/en-US.ts`        | English: spreads `system/en-US.ts`, then adds the application's own groups; defines the structure of all the copy and exports the type `AppResource` |
| `client/locales/zh-CN.ts`        | Chinese: spreads `system/zh-CN.ts`, then adds the same groups; typed as `AppResource`, so its structure must match the English                       |
| `client/locales/index.ts`        | One dynamic `import()` per language, so the browser downloads only the language being shown                                                          |

Rules:

- Write the application's copy in `client/locales/en-US.ts` and `zh-CN.ts`, never in `client/locales/system/`. The system files belong to the template, and a template upgrade replaces them; keeping the two apart is what lets it do so without touching the application's copy.
- A group the application writes replaces the system group of the same name rather than merging with it. To add a key to a shared group such as `navigation` or `appearance`, spread the system group first: `navigation: { ...systemEnUS.navigation, projects: 'Projects' }`, and the same with `systemZhCN` in `zh-CN.ts`. Rewording a system key works the same way: write the key after the spread.
- Each new feature gets its own group (`projects: { … }`), which holds all of the feature's copy.
- Add menu titles to the existing `navigation` group (`navigation.projects`), and write `navigation: { title: 'navigation.projects' }` in the route (see [`page.md`](page.md)).
- Add the key to `en-US.ts` first, then add the same key to `zh-CN.ts`. A key missing from `zh-CN.ts` or extra in it (including a misspelled one) fails type checking.
- The sign-in pages' copy is the flat `auth.*` keys; the authentication blocks in `client/extensions/nocobase-auth-*/` take their text as props, so `client/pages/auth/` passes these translations in.

# Application Development Guidelines

This is a NocoBase 3 application. Do not apply globally installed NocoBase 2 Skills. You are building the application itself — its pages, its API, its database tables. Everything under this directory is application-owned source code that you may edit directly.

Do not create a plugin to add a feature. Plugins are separately published packages for capabilities shared across several applications; building one for this application's own feature adds a package boundary, a version, and a release process to work that belongs in `client/` and `server/`. Create one only when the user explicitly asks for a reusable published package.

## Default template scope

Default is the clean application starting point. It registers product capabilities but no `app-plugin-*-example` plugins, example pages, application sample services, or sample APIs. Keep runnable demonstrations in `app-template-examples`. Application-owned business server routes start empty; Users supplies the standard Permission Set role scope. Application-owned pages include the localized homepage and inbox; prepared user/role administration modules are unregistered in the bare template and enabled as business capabilities are developed.

`database/main/` contains required permission initialization only; application-owned business migrations and seeds start empty. Do not add article history, demo seeds, or compatibility copies from Examples to this template. Existing installations retain their own executed migration sources when upgrading; see the [upgrade migration rules](.agents/skills/nocobase-app-upgrade/references/edge-cases.md#migrations).

## Keeping this file small

This file stays at most 32 KB and must not grow without bound, because every agent loads it on every start. It holds only the rules that apply everywhere and an index of where the detail lives.

- Application-specific guidance — including what a change to this application's structure, shell or conventions needs the next agent to know — goes in `.agents/rules/<topic>.md`. Update the relevant file, or add one, and add or update its entry in the [index](#index) below rather than writing the detail here.
- Framework-wide guidance lives in the synchronized Skills under `.agents/skills/`. Link to it, never copy it here; when it is wrong for every application, correct it upstream in `@nocobase/app-skills`.
- `tests/logic/agents-md.test.ts` enforces the size limit and checks that the links here and in `.agents/rules/` resolve.

## Load the development skills

`pnpm install` runs `pnpm nocobase skills sync` through the application's `postinstall` hook. If `.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/` is missing, install dependencies from the application root; if install scripts were disabled or synchronized Skills are stale, run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` explicitly.

[`.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/SKILL.md) holds the detailed guidance behind this file. Read it first — it routes to the reference that matches your task. Read the one page your task needs, not the whole directory.

Read it when the task is upgrading the template rather than building a feature — including when the user asks to upgrade NocoBase or its core version, because a newer template release is how this application moves to a newer NocoBase — and read it before touching anything — an upgrade done by copying the newest template over this application destroys the work that made it this application.

`.agents/skills/nocobase-deployment/` covers moving this application from source to a production server: building for the target platform, what the archive does and does not carry, migrations and business data, production configuration, and what to verify afterwards. Read it before building for deployment, and when an application starts in production but does not work.

## Where things go

Business code goes in these places. This is where you work, and where you should stay unless the task genuinely requires otherwise:


| Field                   | Current contract                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `key`                   | Required; matches `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$`; unique within the application. Application name and key form persistent identity, so renaming is not an in-place update |
| `title` / `description` | Required title / optional description                                                                                                                                      |
| `schedule.cron`         | Five fields starting with minutes, or six starting with seconds; `*/5 * * * *` runs every five minutes, `*/10 * * * * *` every ten seconds                                 |
| `schedule.timezone`     | Defaults to `UTC`; use an explicit IANA timezone and consider daylight saving changes for local business time                                                              |
| `schedule.from` / `to`  | Optional inclusive `Date` boundaries; construct from ISO timestamps with explicit timezone offsets; from must not exceed to                                                |
| `schedule.limit`        | Optional positive integer; counts firings started, not successful completions. Disabling and re-enabling or changing the definition continues from the firings already run |
| `target.type`           | A target type the application or a plugin registered. There is no built-in type                                                                                            |
| `target.config`         | JSON object; no functions, Service instances, or credentials. Sensitive field names are rejected recursively                                                               |
